reason: Close the Layered CI semantic gap for trusted delegated product work packages by routing them through L2 Work Package verification, without weakening or altering L3 Promotion/WP7 release-candidate gates.

evidence.layeredSemanticFinding: L2 is Work Package verification; L3 Promotion is release-candidate verification. Model Brain explicitly forbids promotion/productionRelease/publish while requiring Layered GREEN.

mandatoryContracts: Delegated product Layered closure maps to L2 Work Package verification; it never maps to or weakens L3 Promotion.
Candidate classification is derived from trusted-main delegated authorization and verified Git history, never branch prefix or candidate-owned authorization content alone.
The trusted authorization must have been introduced by exactly one ordinary two-parent main merge with the reviewed authorization Head as parent2 and the authorization base as parent1.
The implementation Head must descend from the effective authorization merge and the exact remote implementation branch tip must equal the candidate SHA.
The candidate commit SHA and expected tree are both exact lowercase 40-character Git object IDs and candidate^{tree} must equal expected tree.
The actual authorization-merge..candidate changed path set must exactly equal the trusted authorization implementation.allowedChangedPaths; subset-only acceptance is forbidden.
The actual changed path count and canonical SHA-256 must exactly match approvedChangedFileCount and approvedChangedFileSetSha256 from trusted main.
Unknown, ambiguous, superseded, stale, missing, malformed or conflicting authority/ref/tree/scope inputs fail closed.
Dependency-control and workflow-control behavior remains governed by the trusted authorization exact policies; candidate self-report cannot expand either surface.
L3 Promotion, WP7, Activation, WP6, final-build, installer identity and source-delivery parent-chain contracts remain unchanged and are never skipped by this work package.
No Model Brain product path and no PR #158 implementation path is modified by this governance work package.
